name: 可可影视
script: if(window.__sniffBridgeInited!==true){async function getSearchUrl(keyword){const input=await waitForElement('.search-input',10,500);if(!input){return}input.value=keyword;var btn=document.querySelector('.search-bar .sub-btn');btn.click()}async function sniffResource(keyword){const result=await waitForElement('.search-result-list',10,500);if(!result){sendResourceList([]);return}const list=result.querySelectorAll('.search-result-item');if(!list||0==list.length){sendResourceList([]);return}const resourceList=[];for(var i=0;i<list.length;i++){var item=list[i];var aWrapper=item;if(!aWrapper){continue}var url=aWrapper.href;var img=item.querySelector('img');var title=item.querySelector('.title').textContent;var blurb=item.querySelector('.desc').textContent.trim();var imgUrl=img.getAttribute('src');if(imgUrl){imgUrl=imgUrl.replace('https://vres.cyscyy.com','https://103.39.111.180:51050',)}resourceList.push({id:getId(url),name:title,url:url,img:imgUrl,blurb:blurb,})}sendResourceList(resourceList)}function sniffEpisode(){var menuList=document.querySelectorAll('.source-list-box-main .source-item',);var sourceList=document.querySelectorAll('.episode-list-box-main .episode-list',);if(!sourceList||sourceList.length==0){sendSourceMap({});return}var sourceMap={};for(var i=0;i<sourceList.length;i++){var episodeList=sourceList[i].querySelectorAll('a.episode-item');if(episodeList.length==0){continue}const sourceLabel=menuList[i].querySelector('.source-item-label').textContent;if(sourceLabel=='4K'){continue}const sourceSublabel=menuList[i].querySelector('.source-item-sublabel',).textContent;let sourceName=sourceLabel+'('+sourceSublabel+')';sourceMap[sourceName]=Array.from(episodeList).map((item)=>({name:item.querySelector('span').textContent,url:item.href,}))}sendSourceMap(sourceMap)}async function sniffPlayUrl(){var video=await waitForElement('video',10,500);if(!video){sendPlayUrl('')}video.muted=true;if(video.src&&!video.src.startsWith('blob:')){sendPlayUrl(video.src)}}function waitForElement(selector,maxRetry=10,intervalMs=200){return new Promise((resolve)=>{let count=0;function poll(){const el=document.querySelector(selector);if(el){resolve(el);return}count++;if(count>=maxRetry){resolve(null);return}setTimeout(poll,intervalMs)}poll()})}function getId(uri){const url=new URL(uri);const path=url.pathname;const filename=path.split('/').pop();return filename.replace('.html','')}window.taskSniffSearchUrl=function(keyword){sniffLog('开始执行任务：获取搜索链接');getSearchUrl(keyword);sniffLog('任务执行完成：获取搜索链接')};window.taskSniffResource=function(keyword){sniffLog('开始执行任务：获取资源信息');sniffResource(keyword);sniffLog('任务执行完成：获取资源信息')};window.taskSniffEpisode=function(){sniffLog('开始执行任务：获取分集列表');sniffEpisode();sniffLog('任务执行完成：获取分集列表')};window.taskSniffPlayUrl=function(){sniffLog('开始执行任务：嗅探播放地址');sniffPlayUrl();sniffLog('任务执行完成：嗅探播放地址')};function sendToFlutter(msg){if(!window.FlutterBridge)return;window.FlutterBridge.postMessage(JSON.stringify(msg))}function sniffLog(text){sendToFlutter({msgType:'log',payload:String(text)})}function sendResourceList(list){sendToFlutter({msgType:'resourceList',payload:list})}function sendEpisodeList(list){sendToFlutter({msgType:'episodeList',payload:list})}function sendSourceMap(map){sendToFlutter({msgType:'sourceMap',payload:map})}function sendPlayUrl(url){sendToFlutter({msgType:'playUrl',payload:String(url)})}function sendLoadIframe(url){sendToFlutter({msgType:'loadIframe',payload:String(url)})}window.__sniffBridgeInited=true}else{if(typeof sniffLog!=='undefined'){sniffLog('桥接脚本已存在，跳过重复注入')}}
